title: Root DIO signature (spec 8.10.1): Python crypto oracle only — no DIO option in C/Rust, no root_seq cache keyed (dodag_id,instance), no CONFIG_LICHEN_RPL_ROOT_SIG
description: Requirements (spec/06-security.md:587-700): receiver validation steps for the COSE_Sign1 root signature DIO option including Cache root_seq keyed by (dodag_id, instance) (L668); Nodes MUST NOT reject DIOs solely due to missing root signature validation capability (L679); root_seq MUST NOT wrap (L687); Root SHOULD include the signature option when CONFIG_LICHEN_RPL_ROOT_SIG=y (L694). Classification: implemented+untested (Python crypto oracle); not-implemented (receiver integration, root_seq cache, Kconfig). Evidence: python/src/lichen/crypto/root_dio_signature.py verify_root_dio_signature:278-362 (kid, alg, signature, expiry, seq>cached parameter, DIO field cross-checks) with 20 unit tests (python/tests/crypto/test_root_dio_signature.py) and vectors test/vectors/root_dio_signature.json. NOT FOUND: root-sig option in rust/lichen-rpl/src/message.rs option table (lines 71-80) or C rpl option parsing; root_seq cache keyed (dodag_id,instance) anywhere (cached_seq is a bare parameter with zero production callers); CONFIG_LICHEN_RPL_ROOT_SIG Kconfig. Doc-only bug: stale docstring example h a10139ffff (= -65536) at root_dio_signature.py:169 while encoder emits a1013a00010000. Suggested placement: rust lichen-rpl message options + node DIO receive path; C rpl option parse + rpl Kconfig; root_seq cache in DODAG state.
